description: This Java class implements a rule node for the Thingsboard platform that handles saving device attributes, with configurable processing strategies, scopes, and notifications. It processes messages of type POST_ATTRIBUTES_REQUEST, determines save strategies, and interacts with the telemetry service to save attributes and notify other components.

classes.name: TbMsgAttributesNode
classes.description: Implements a rule node for saving device attributes with configurable strategies, scope, and notifications in Thingsboard.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration and processing settings.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, determines strategy, and saves attributes accordingly.

methods.name: determineSaveStrategy
methods.description: Determines the attribute save strategy based on processing settings and message metadata.

methods.name: saveAttr
methods.description: Saves the list of attributes to the telemetry service and handles notifications.

methods.name: checkSendNotification
methods.description: Checks if attribute update notifications should be sent based on configuration and scope.

methods.name: checkNotifyDeviceMdValue
methods.description: Determines whether to notify the device based on metadata value.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute scope from message metadata or configuration.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Handles upgrading configuration from older versions.

methods.name: fixEscapedBooleanConfigParameter
methods.description: Fixes boolean configuration parameters that are stored as text.
